delpax.translation: 复合运动感应式传感器

delph.definition:
n. Delftware.
n. The drain on the land side of a sea embankment.
delph.translation: [人名] 德尔夫; [地名] [英国] 德尔夫

delphi.definition: n. an ancient Greek city on the slopes of Mount Parnassus; site of the oracle of Delphi

delphian.definition: a of or relating to Delphi or to the oracles of Apollo at Delphi
delphian.translation: a. 模棱两可的, 暧昧的

delphic.definition:
a. of or relating to Delphi or to the oracles of Apollo at Delphi
s. obscurely prophetic
delphic.translation: a. (阿波罗)神谕的,意义不明确的,暧昧的

delphin.definition:
a. Alt. of Delphine
n. A fatty substance contained in the oil of the dolphin and
   the porpoise; -- called also phocenin.
delphin.translation: a. （1349年至1830年间）为法国王太子所用的；法国王储的

delphine.definition:
a. Pertaining to the dauphin of France; as, the Delphin
   classics, an edition of the Latin classics, prepared in the reign of
   Louis XIV., for the use of the dauphin (in usum Delphini).
a. Pertaining to the dolphin, a genus of fishes.

delphinia.definition: n any plant of the genus Delphinium having palmately divided leaves and showy spikes of variously colored spurred flowers; some contain extremely poisonous substances
delphinia.translation: n. 黛尔芬妮娅(Delphine的异体)(f.)

delphinidin.translation: [化] 翠雀色素; 花翠素; 飞燕草色素

delphinidin chloride.translation: [化] 氯化翠雀色素; 氯化飞燕草色素

delphinin.translation: n. [化]翠雀苷,花翠苷,飞燕草色素苷

delphinine.definition:
n. A poisonous alkaloid extracted from the stavesacre
   (Delphinium staphisagria), as a colorless amorphous powder.

delphinium.definition: n. any plant of the genus Delphinium having palmately divided leaves and showy spikes of variously colored spurred flowers; some contain extremely poisonous substances
delphinium.translation: n. 飞燕草, 靛蓝色

delphiniums.definition: n. any plant of the genus Delphinium having palmately divided leaves and showy spikes of variously colored spurred flowers; some contain extremely poisonous substances
delphiniums.translation: n. 飞燕草, 飞燕草子, 翠雀花( delphinium的复数形式 )

delphinoid.definition: a. Pertaining to, or resembling, the dolphin.
delphinoid.translation:
a. (动物)海豚类的,似海豚的
n. 海豚类动物

delphinoidea.definition:
n. pl. The division of Cetacea which comprises the
   dolphins, porpoises, and related forms.

delphinoidine.translation:
[化] 翠雀定
[医] 翠雀次硷

delphinus.definition:
n. a constellation in the northern hemisphere near Pegasus and Aquila
n. type genus of the Delphinidae

delphinus delphis.translation: [网络] 海豚；真海豚；短喙真海豚

delphis.definition: n an ancient Greek city on the slopes of Mount Parnassus; site of the oracle of Delphi

delphisine.translation:
[化] 翠雀素
[医] 异翠雀硷

delphology.translation: n. (科技未来学中从事预测方法研究的)特尔斐学, 准确预测方法学

delphos.translation: [人名] 德尔福斯; [地名] [美国] 德尔弗斯

delphys.translation: (delphy 的复数) n. (Delphy)人名；(法)德尔菲
